destination_ips.semantic_explanation: NexSolve tracks 108 total destination IP entities: 41 IPv4, 59 IPv6, and 8 ARP target IPs (pdst) that only appear as ARP targets.

directional_5tuples.semantic_explanation: NexSolve filters for Layer 4 TCP and UDP 5-tuples with valid L4 ports (867 tuples). The remaining 10 tuples are non-port protocols: ICMP, ICMPv6, IGMP, and IPv6-NoNxt.

bidirectional_tuples.semantic_explanation: NexSolve canonical flow pairs 436 TCP/UDP bidirectional flow tuples. The remaining 8 tuples belong to ICMP and ICMPv6 unported control exchanges.

reconstructed_flows.semantic_explanation: NexSolve reconstructs 453 canonical flow objects from raw packets using 60-second idle timeout boundaries and TCP FIN/RST session termination, splitting long-lived TCP/UDP 5-tuples into distinct temporal flow instances.
